formulas.name: B9_GSIGN_CONTANGO_FADE
formulas.mechanism: VIX9D/VIX3M is the sign of the dealer gamma book: deep contango = long gamma = intraday moves get absorbed; backwardation = short gamma = they get amplified

formulas.name: B10_GSIGN_BACKWARD_RIDE
formulas.mechanism: VIX9D/VIX3M is the sign of the dealer gamma book: deep contango = long gamma = intraday moves get absorbed; backwardation = short gamma = they get amplified

formulas.name: B11_GSIGN_CONTANGO_LASTHR

formulas.name: B12_GSIGN_BACKWARD_LASTHR

formulas.name: B13_VANNA_SKEWxDVOL
formulas.mechanism: dealers short a rich put wing carry positive vanna: a vol DROP mechanically raises their delta and forces spot buying, scaled by how rich the wing is
formulas.sign: LONG when skew is rich AND vol fell; product sign fixed by the vanna identity

formulas.name: B14_CHARM_EXPIRY_DRIFT
formulas.mechanism: charm: as monthly expiry approaches, the delta of a dealer's short OTM put decays toward zero, forcing him to buy back the spot he sold as a hedge
formulas.sign: LONG the run-in to monthly expiry when the put wing is rich; fixed by charm sign

formulas.name: B15_CONTROL_UNCOND_FADE
formulas.mechanism: CONTROL -- unconditional intraday fade, contains no options or dealer information whatsoever
formulas.sign: FADE always. Any dealer formula must beat THIS, not zero.

formulas.name: B16_OVERNIGHT_REV_LONGGAMMA
formulas.mechanism: a long-gamma dealer book has to buy the close down / sell it up, and the flow unwinds against him overnight -- the reversal T3 trades should be LARGER here
formulas.sign: sign set by the gamma regime, not by fitting; interaction test against the basket's T3 overnight reversal

formulas.name: B17_OVERNIGHT_REV_SHORTGAMMA
formulas.mechanism: a short-gamma book chases the close, so the overnight session should CONTINUE, not revert
formulas.sign: sign set by the gamma regime, not by fitting; interaction test against the basket's T3 overnight reversal

formulas.name: B18_OPEX_AM_SETTLE_GAP
formulas.mechanism: SPX AM-settled monthly options print off the opening auction, so the unwind of the hedge against them lands in the overnight gap
formulas.sign: LONG the expiry-morning gap; sign fixed by the direction of the unwind

formulas.name: C1_V1D_RICH_MOMENTUM
formulas.mechanism: VIX1D rich to VIX = the day's flow is concentrated in 0DTE, where dealers are net SHORT gamma, so an intraday move gets chased not absorbed
formulas.sign: FOLLOW the morning move on heavy-0DTE days; sign fixed by short-gamma

formulas.name: C2_V1D_CHEAP_FADE
formulas.mechanism: VIX1D cheap to VIX = little 0DTE demand, dealers keep the longer-dated long-gamma book, so intraday moves are absorbed
formulas.sign: FADE the morning move on light-0DTE days; sign fixed by long-gamma

formulas.name: C3_V1D_RICH_LASTHOUR
formulas.mechanism: 0DTE gamma goes hyperbolic in the final hour; a short-gamma dealer's hedge is self-reinforcing right into settlement
formulas.sign: FOLLOW the 13:00-15:00 move into the close on heavy-0DTE days

formulas.name: C4_V1DSLOPE_RICH_MOM
formulas.mechanism: VIX1D - VIX9D is the pure 0DTE kink in the term structure, cleaner than the VIX1D/VIX ratio which carries the whole level
formulas.sign: FOLLOW the morning move when the 0DTE kink is steep

formulas.name: C5_V1D_VRP_SIGNFLIP
formulas.mechanism: a fat 0DTE variance premium means the vol sellers are solvent and supplying gamma (dealers long) -> next-day reversal; a negative one means they have been run over (dealers short) -> next-day continuation
formulas.sign: REVERSE when 0DTE VRP is fat, CONTINUE when thin; both signs fixed in advance

formulas.name: C6_V1D_SPIKE_CONTINUE
formulas.mechanism: a VIX1D spike is a rush into same-day protection; the dealer selling it is short gamma at the money and must sell into weakness
formulas.sign: CONTINUE the day's move after a 0DTE-vol spike; fixed by short-gamma

formulas.name: A1_GEX_SIGN_AUTOCORR
formulas.mechanism: net dealer gamma built from real per-strike SPY option volume across every expiry inside 5 sessions: positive net gamma makes hedging counter-trend (reversal), negative makes it pro-trend (momentum)
formulas.sign: REVERSE when net gamma > 0, CONTINUE when < 0; both fixed by the hedging identity

formulas.name: A1b_GEX_SIGN_LAGSAFE
formulas.mechanism: A1's mechanism, entered at the next cash open so no position is ever taken on an option bar that has not printed
formulas.sign: REVERSE when net gamma > 0, CONTINUE when < 0; lag-safe entry

formulas.name: A2_GAMMA_CofM_PIN
formulas.mechanism: the gamma-weighted centre of mass of the near-dated strike ladder is where a long-gamma dealer book has the least to hedge; spot is drawn to it
formulas.sign: LONG when the centre of mass sits above spot; fixed by the pin mechanism

formulas.name: A3_GAMMA_CofM_INTRADAY
formulas.mechanism: as A2 but the pull is claimed to act during the cash session when the hedging actually happens, not across the overnight gap
formulas.sign: LONG when the centre of mass sits above spot; open-to-close

formulas.name: A4_GAMMA_FLIP_LEVEL
formulas.mechanism: the strike at which the running net gamma profile crosses zero: above it dealers are long gamma and damp, below it short and amplify
formulas.sign: REVERSE above the flip, CONTINUE below; fixed by the profile's sign

formulas.name: A4b_GAMMA_FLIP_LAGSAFE
formulas.mechanism: A4's mechanism entered at the next cash open
formulas.sign: REVERSE above the flip, CONTINUE below; lag-safe entry

formulas.name: A5_PUTGAMMA_SURGE
formulas.mechanism: a day-on-day collapse in the call/put gamma balance is a hedging rush: the dealer taking the other side is newly short downside gamma and will have to sell spot into any further weakness
formulas.sign: SHORT when the balance swings to puts; fixed by the short-gamma channel

formulas.name: A9_RELGAMMA_AUTOCORR
formulas.mechanism: the call/put gamma balance relative to its own expanding history: an unusually call-heavy book is the long-gamma regime (damping), an unusually put-heavy one is the short-gamma regime (amplifying)
formulas.sign: REVERSE in the relatively-long-gamma regime, CONTINUE in the short one; both fixed by the hedging identity

formulas.name: A9b_RELGAMMA_LAGSAFE
formulas.mechanism: the call/put gamma balance relative to its own expanding history: an unusually call-heavy book is the long-gamma regime (damping), an unusually put-heavy one is the short-gamma regime (amplifying)
formulas.sign: REVERSE in the relatively-long-gamma regime, CONTINUE in the short one; both fixed by the hedging identity

formulas.name: A6_CALL_WALL_RESIST
formulas.mechanism: the strike carrying the most call gamma above spot is where dealer supply is thickest; spot stalls there
formulas.sign: sign fixed by which wall spot is against

formulas.name: A7_PUT_WALL_SUPPORT

formulas.sign: sign fixed by which wall spot is against

formulas.name: A8_BIG_GAMMA_CLAMP
formulas.mechanism: when the absolute size of the near-dated gamma book is large, hedging volume dominates the tape and the morning move gets absorbed
